overview.description: The United States 12 Month Natural Gas Fund LP (UNL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the 12 Month Natural Gas index. The fund holds the 12 nearest-month NYMEX natural gas futures contracts in equal weights. UNL was launched on Nov 18, 2009 and is issued by Marygold.
